{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()

# Check value counts for key categorical variables
sex_counts = df['sex'].value_counts()
arm_counts = df['arm'].value_counts()
severity_counts = df['severity'].value_counts()

# Check the response rate by sex
response_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# Check if the groups are comparable (e.g., age, severity, arm, site)
comparison_table = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['arm'], margins=True)
comparison_table_severity = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['severity'], margins=True)
comparison_table_site = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['site'], margins=True)

missing_values, duplicates, sex_counts, arm_counts, severity_counts, response_by_sex, comparison_table, comparison_table_severity, comparison_table_site"}
